data.name: Nayyir
data.gender_notes: Nayyir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-w-r', meaning 'to be rare, precious, or valuable'. In Islamic literature, it is attributed to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions. The name Nayyir carries the meaning “Rare, Precious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nayyir usually hope their child will grow to embody rare, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are rare and valuable in the eyes of Allah.
data.etymology: Nayyir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rare, Precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nayyir total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Nayyir" evokes a sense of rarity, grace, and distinction. It is a name that is cherished in the Arab and Muslim communities due to its noble origins and unique sound. In many Islamic cultures, names reflect an individual's identity, character, and aspirations. A name like Nayyir is seen as an inspiring and uplifting choice for a child, as it signifies the hope and expectation that the person will grow up to be a valuable and precious contributor to their family, community, and broader society. It is also a name that resonates with the Islamic value of striving for excellence and distinguished achievement in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Nayyir" is believed to have a deeper significance, reminding us of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) character and teachings. The Prophet was a man of rare and precious virtues, known for his kindness, mercy, wisdom, and patience. He set an example for his followers to be noble, pure, and gracious, and to seek valuable knowledge and wisdom in their lives. The name "Nayyir" serves as an inspiration to strive for these qualities in our own character and actions, and to treasure the blessings and gifts that Allah bestows upon us.
